status: DECLARED after the development-table exploration listed below and BEFORE any twelve-month reading of this layer: the twelve-month exploration run was still on its second of twelve folds when this file was written, and its output was not read. The governing run (tools/scout_var_alloc.py --score) recomputes both tables.
what_is_different: v48 moves every ordinary row of an airport-day by the same posterior day shift plus a first-order tilt whose size comes from the row's cell (airport, ADS-B match, schedule-interval band, prediction band). This layer re-allocates the day's discrepancy between rows by a learned, label-free estimate of each row's error variance and chance of a visible delay: rows the model expects to carry more of the day's error move more, the others less, with zero net change per airport-day before the cap. It does not change the day's level (v48 and the extreme-day layer keep that) and never moves heavy rows or the LIRF population.

procedure.position: a layer after the extreme-day layer: model part -> v48's reconciliation -> extreme-day layer (configs/scout_extreme_shift_v1.json) -> this layer; on v55's chain for the ranking
procedure.I_d: the extreme-day layer's implied shift of the airport-day: -(published - c0_a - implied total) / n_eff over in-figure rows (IFR only at EHAM / LSZH / LEBL), c0_a from the fitting months; every airport-day with a published total and n_eff >= 1, clipped to [-600, 600] s; 0 on rows of days the table marks incomplete
procedure.eligible: rows in the figure and moved by v48 (heavy rows and rows of unread days keep their value), not the LIRF population (cls LIRF_pop)
procedure.variance_model: LightGBM regression of log(r^2 + 100), r = label - the extreme-day layer's value, on eligible fitting rows with |r| < 1800 s; late model: LightGBM binary of (a > label) on eligible fitting rows; settings for both: learning rate 0.05, 15 leaves, min_data_in_leaf 2000, feature_fraction 0.8, bagging 0.8 every round, lambda_l2 10, 300 rounds, seed 20261002
procedure.inputs: label-free: airport, ADS-B match, schedule interval a, prediction (the model part), a - prediction, takeoff hour (UTC, fractional), AOBT_3 present, (takeoff - AOBT_3) - prediction, (takeoff - EOBT_1) - a, (takeoff - LOBT) - prediction, wake category, market segment, rows of the airport-day
procedure.weights: w_i = exp(variance model) x P(late); wr_i = w_i / mean of w over the eligible rows of its airport-day
procedure.update: c_i = clip(k x I_d x (wr_i - 1), -100, 100) s; value + c_i, floor -12 s; nearest integer in the export
procedure.k: least-squares slope through zero of r on I_d x (wr - 1) over eligible fitting rows with |r| < 1800 s (fitting months only; their weights out-of-fold as in the governing run); on the ranking from the four development months
procedure.fitting_side: development month m: both models and k from the other development months (stack table) or the other eleven months (twelve-month table); the extreme-day layer under it fitted the same way (as its own governing run); ranking: models and k from the four development months
procedure.free_parameters: k only, fitted on the fitting months; the cap (100 s), the clip (600 s) and the model settings are fixed here and were not tuned on the twelve-month table

rule.text: accepted when (1) no development month is worse than the control (the extreme-day layer on v48's procedure) by more than 0.005% of its RMSE (all rows); (2) the mean change over the equal-footing months is at least 0.02% below zero; (3) every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval (by off-block day, seed 20260929) lies below zero; (4) in the twelve-month check no month is worse than its control by more than 0.005% and at least two thirds of the months are better. November is reported in (1).
